description: Source code for loading and processing TrueType font kerning tables in the FreeType project, including functions for loading, parsing, and retrieving kerning data.

methods.name: tt_face_load_kern
methods.description: Loads the kerning table from a font face stream, parses its contents, and initializes related data structures.

methods.name: tt_face_done_kern
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the kerning table in a font face.

methods.name: tt_face_get_kerning
methods.description: Retrieves the kerning value between two glyphs from the loaded kerning tables.
